description: Retrospective betting-indicator results for the saved default model
important_note: These thresholds were selected after reviewing 2024 and 2025. Results are promising but are not an unbiased estimate of future performance.

moneyline.rule: Bet the model-predicted winner when model win confidence is at least 0.625
moneyline.calibration_warning: Treat the value as model win confidence, not a calibrated probability. Direct model-versus-market implied-probability edge performed poorly.

spread.rule: Bet the model side when absolute model-versus-market spread edge is at least 4.0 points
